text:
The customer received a replacement hub (order LM-46855) with an incompatible US-style power adapter after their original hub failed, and became frustrated after multiple transfers and an unfulfilled promise on earlier calls. They want the correct power adapter, a personal non-template written apology, and assurance that they will not have to repeat their issue in the future. 

So far, the agent has apologized, dispatched the correct adapter (tracking LMT-5521-014-IN), and added a detailed history note to the customer's account. Next, the agent needs to send the promised personal written apology via email and monitor that the replacement adapter is delivered properly.
